products.title: Aera Swivel Lounge Chair – Cream Fabric
products.description: The Maple Aera Swivel Lounge Chair combines understated elegance with unbeatable comfort. Upholstered in soft cream fabric and designed with generous cushioning, this chair features a 360° swivel base for versatile movement. Perfect for cozy evenings, stylish lounging, or as an elegant reading nook companion — it’s the epitome of refined living.Crafted for modern interiors with clean lines and plush seating, the Aera is both timeless and functional. Whether styled solo or paired with matching seating, it brings calm sophistication to any room.

products.title: Aileron Signature Bed
products.description: This luxury upholstered bed features a sophisticated contemporary silhouette with an oversized textured headboard framed in rich dark walnut wood. Designed with soft neutral upholstery, integrated floating aesthetics, and refined architectural detailing, the bed creates a calm, elegant, and immersive bedroom environment inspired by timeless modern luxury.

products.title: Aileron Upholstered Bench
products.description: This upholstered bench features a refined minimalist silhouette with textured neutral fabric seating and a solid dark walnut wood frame. Designed to complement contemporary bedroom and lounge interiors, the bench combines architectural simplicity with soft luxurious comfort, making it ideal as an end-of-bed bench or accent seating piece.

products.title: Alcyone 7+-seater sofa
products.description: The Alcyone is the living room at its most complete — a full suite of sofa, armchairs and bench, each piece upholstered in the richest emerald velvet and raised on open gold metal frames that lend the ensemble an airy, almost regal lightness. Designed to be experienced as a whole, it commands the room with the authority of something commissioned, not simply chosen. The rarest expression of considered luxury.

products.title: Alina 7+-seater sofa
products.description: The Alina fills an entire room with quiet grandeur — a sweeping U-shaped sectional in soft greige linen whose deep, generous seats seem designed not merely for sitting, but for the kind of long evenings that are worth remembering. Espresso block feet mark the base with dark, grounding warmth. Scale has rarely felt this considered, or this effortless.

products.title: Alto Luxe Lounge Chair – Matte Gold Frame with Charcoal Upholstery
products.description: Add modern elegance to any space with the Alto Luxe Lounge Chair — a striking combination of clean lines and plush comfort. Featuring a sleek brushed gold metal frame and deep charcoal grey cushioning, this chair delivers a bold aesthetic while staying incredibly inviting.Its low-slung seat and firm-yet-soft cushions offer ergonomic support, making it perfect for relaxed reading, morning chai, or sunset balcony conversations.From urban apartments to stylish studios, this piece is a refined statement in any modern setting.
